data_description.password: Enter the exact password you use in the iSmart app. Avoid trailing spaces when pasting. Very long passwords generated by a password manager can fail here even though the app accepts them, because SAIC's servers shorten them when they are set — if login fails with a long password, set a shorter one (around 16 characters or fewer) in the app and use that.

custom_region.title: Custom API Endpoint
custom_region.description: Enter the SAIC API endpoint details for your region. Only use this if your country is not covered by a built-in region (e.g. Thailand). See the integration documentation for known endpoints.

select_vehicle.title: Select Vehicle
select_vehicle.description: Select the vehicle to be added and revise the vehicle type.

vehicle_capabilities.title: Vehicle Capabilities
vehicle_capabilities.description: Select any additional capabilities your vehicle supports. You can change them later in the Options menu if needed.

india_pin.title: MG India PIN
india_pin.description: Enter your 4-digit iSmart PIN (the same PIN used to authorise commands in the iSmart India app). Only a secure hash of the PIN is stored, never the PIN itself.

reauth_confirm.title: Update MG SAIC Password
reauth_confirm.description: The stored password for {username} is no longer working, or you asked to update it. Enter the current iSmart password to reconnect — the rest of your settings are kept.

data_description.password: Avoid trailing spaces when pasting. If a long password-manager password fails, set a shorter one (around 16 characters or fewer) in the iSmart app and enter that.

error.auth: Failed to authenticate, please check your credentials.
error.invalid_pin: The PIN must be exactly 4 digits.

data_description.abrp_user_token: Paste the user token from the ABRP app (Settings → your car → Live Data → Generic) to send this vehicle's data to A Better Route Planner. You also need your own API key (below) — both are required. Leave both blank to disable. See {abrp_doc_url}.
data_description.abrp_api_key: Enter your own Iternio API key, created in the Iternio developer portal — see {abrp_doc_url}. Required together with the user token to enable ABRP.

error.abrp_invalid_auth: ABRP rejected the token/key. Check both and try again.
error.abrp_cannot_connect: Could not reach ABRP to validate the token. Check your connection and retry.
error.abrp_no_api_key: Enter your ABRP API key as well as your user token — both are required to enable ABRP.
error.abrp_unknown: Unexpected error validating the ABRP token.
